description: Post-manuscript robustness addendum: seed-level bootstrap CIs extended to Table II/IV/VI, plus calibration-temperature and adaptation-fold sensitivity sweeps. No model retrained; no frozen confirmation procedure modified; all inputs are the already-committed seed-level CSVs and seed-42 .npz prediction archives under artifacts/redesign_v3/results/.

robustness_bootstrap_extended.csv.method: seed-level bootstrap, rng=default_rng(42), 20000 repetitions per group

adaptation_fold_sensitivity_seed42.csv.note: includes n_nonconvergent count per group -- some small-fold draws produce non-convergent temperature fits, reported honestly rather than excluded silently
